description.value: Cactus Club Cafe North Burnaby is an upscale-casual chain restaurant positioned near the Brentwood neighbourhood, offering a chef-driven international menu with a lounge, patio, and private dining spaces. The stylish, full-service venue draws a lively crowd and covers the full day with lunch, dinner, happy hour, and late-night service. Touring cyclists will find a sit-down meal with pickup and delivery options as well as a patio for outdoor seating.
